narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.27 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.6625-0.6684 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.6735; the first objective pays 2.11R at 0.6627.
